am absolutely disgusted with the level of care I’ve received or more accurately, not received from this practice. I have been suffering from a serious eye infection for over five months, and despite multiple attempts to seek help, I’ve been continuously ignored, dismissed, or passed around without any proper examination, diagnosis, or treatment.
This is not a minor complaint this is a long-term medical issue that could result in lasting damage, and yet no one here seems to care in the slightest. I’ve been made to feel like an inconvenience rather than a patient in need of medical attention.
The complete lack of urgency, follow-up, or basic human compassion is absolutely unacceptable. What exactly is the purpose of a GP if not to provide care when it is urgently needed? I’ve never experienced such cold, careless, and frankly negligent treatment from a healthcare provider.
If you're looking for a GP who will actually listen, care, and treat you like a human being, go elsewhere. This practice has shown me nothing but indifference, and I would never recommend them to anyone who values their health or peace of mind.",null,[0,237]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pScmIzaE5ZMHRTY1RCZlNEZGlWMDQzZG5CcmRuYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x6a87110137d0a4c7!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOjRrb3hNY0tScTBfSDdiV043dnBrdnc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pScmIzaE5ZMHRTY1RCZlNEZGlWMDQzZG5CcmRuYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjqgfyt87GTAxX8I2MBHZ52OlgQoykIFigB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjqgfyt87GTAxX8I2MBHZ52OlgQ0pMFCBQoBg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMkZUT0hkUlZGOWZSV2hCV2xaVldpMUlVa1ptWW1rNVJHUk5kMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpZZDBOYWNFeDZRa0pOV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURQOWVqUk53EAE",["0x0:0x6a87110137d0a4c7",null,1733317599724932,1733319136278840,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107854366958176138734/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Luci claire Evans","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVNWjwyu9tnbSyk5-5kP1t7kuY5swNg_jWWNqTLxyKwkTMPJGRv=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107854366958176138734?hl=en"],"107854366958176138734",null,8,0,null,[0,3,1],2,["8 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjqgfyt87GTAxX8I2MBHZ52OlgQ7LoGCBgoAA"]]]],null,"a year ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Absolutely awful.
